16K likes, 78 comments - arihantbaidofficial on October 6, 2026: "🇮🇳 5 World-Class Tourist Destinations in India 🇮🇳

1. Smritivan Museum — Gujarat
2. Badami Caves — Karnataka
3. Hampi — Karnataka
4. Forts and palaces — Rajasthan
5. Kashi — Uttar Pradesh

India’s tourism infrastructure, connectivity, safety and maintenance have improved significantly over the years, making our incredible destinations even more accessible to travellers.

With the government’s growing focus on tourism and infrastructure, India recorded 428+ crore domestic tourist visits in 2025 — nearly 3x the 2014 level.
Which Indian destination is your favourite? Tell me in the comments! 👇
Share this reel with your travel partner ❤️
#BadaltaBharatMeriKahani, #25saalsevake".
